sig A { r: set A }
OneOfTwo: run { one A } for 2 but exactly 2 A, 0 Int
OneOfOne: run { one A } for 2 but exactly 1 A, 0 Int
LoneOfOne: run { lone A } for 2 but exactly 1 A, 0 Int
LoneOfTwo: run { lone A } for 2 but exactly 2 A, 0 Int
OneEdge: run { one r and some A } for 2 but 0 Int
LoneLoop: run { lone r and r = A -> A } for 2 but exactly 2 A, 0 Int

sig Owner { one_: one Resource, maybe: lone Resource, many: some Resource }
sig Resource {}
NoOwners: run { no Owner } for 2 but 0 Int
OneOwner: run { one Owner } for 2 but 0 Int
SharedOne: run { some disj a, b: Owner | a.one_ = b.one_ } for 2 but 0 Int
EmptyMaybe: run { some o: Owner | no o.maybe } for 1 but 0 Int
EmptyMany: run { some o: Owner | no o.many } for 2 but 0 Int

sig A { r: set A }
AllSome: run { all x: A | some x.r } for 2 but exactly 2 A, 0 Int
NoneLoop: run { no x: A | x in x.r } for 2 but 0 Int
OneMap: run { one x: A | x.r = A } for 2 but exactly 2 A, 0 Int
LoneMap: run { lone x: A | some x.r } for 2 but exactly 2 A, 0 Int
DisjointPair: run { some disj x, y: A | x.r = y and y.r = x } for 2 but 0 Int
EmptyAll: run { all x: A | x in none } for 2 but 0 Int

sig A { f: set B }
sig B {}
DomainRestrict: run { some a: A | a <: f = a -> a.f and some a.f } for 2 but 0 Int
RangeRestrict: run { some b: B | f :> b != f } for 2 but 0 Int
Transpose: run { ~f = B <: ~f and some f } for 2 but 0 Int
Product: run { f = A -> B and some A and some B } for 2 but 0 Int
Univ: run { univ = A + B } for 2 but 0 Int
